comparison_rule: Equivalent outcomes count; conditional hierarchy, reuse, pagination, download, restricted-category, and reopen obligations apply only when present.

strengths: Exact record/type permissions, approved-Site scope, canonical Site agreement, transactional timeline evidence.
gaps: Current command records an observation entry, not the required template-versioned canonical register.
No general replay/duplicate contract or complete durable provenance; foreign direct objects return 403.
native_preserve: Existing clinical permission split, Site checks, schedule locks, AuditableChanges and timeline transaction.

strengths: Correction fields, relationships, policy capability, and adjacent-owner exclusions are identified.
gaps: No routed production amendment writer, revision lifecycle, direct-object behavior, transaction, stale-state control, or replay contract.
native_preserve: Dormant correction schema/relationships and exact correction capability boundary.

strengths: Existing Client/Site record scope is retained; protocol schedule and wizard Context are correctly rejected as false equivalents.
gaps: No governed care-context/template authority, applicability catalogue, immutable revision, flat applicability filtering, audit decision, privacy behavior, or snapshot contract.
Hierarchy-only precedence is conditional and unscored, but the unconditional flat applicability outcome is also absent.
native_preserve: Fixed observation types and existing approved-Site record filters.

strengths: Exact record authority plus Client view; canonical Site conflict rejection; open event preserves occurrence/report times; event, timeline and required H&S linkage share the core transaction.
gaps: No duplicate/replay identity or exactly-once downstream contract; attachments and signals cross transaction boundaries; first-revision/source provenance is incomplete; foreign objects return 403.
native_preserve: Separate review/follow-up/escalation owners, core transaction, AuditableChanges and canonical Site snapshot.

strengths: Locked incident is re-authorized; competing reviews serialize; repeat review is state-rejected; reviewer/time/notes and audit changes persist.
gaps: No Site assertion permits an in-state direct-bound foreign-Site review; concealment is absent.
Review and closure share incidents.approve; rationale/evidence are optional or absent and notification durability is unestablished.
native_preserve: Incident row lock, locked-state reauthorization, canonical journey repair and reviewer attribution.

strengths: Site access is checked before and under lock; review/follow-up/investigation/H&S blockers are enforced; append-only immutable lifecycle signal and recoverable outbox are transactional.
gaps: Review and close share incidents.approve; reviewer-closer separation and waiver authority are not established.
Closure reason, exact prerequisite-version evidence and ordinary post-close mutation constraints are incomplete; foreign-Site denial is 403.
native_preserve: Canonical parent lock order, strict closure gate, closure attribution, immutable lifecycle signal and outbox.

strengths: All requested Sites are validated, revalidated and locked; normalized identity mutexes prevent concurrent duplicates; core User/profile/roles/Sites/fail-closed audit is atomic.
gaps: Shared manage authority is not an independent create authority; create-or-link can mutate an existing identity.
Invite/onboarding effects are coupled after commit; repeated link may re-audit/re-emit; duplicate and related-object concealment is incomplete.
native_preserve: Atomic intake core, fail-closed audit, Site locks, identity mutexes and elevated-role gates.

strengths: viewAny remains required; field-specific gates are retained; viewAllSites only broadens scope; wholly foreign and provenance-free profiles are concealed 404.
gaps: Sensitive-access purpose/projection audit and effective provenance are not established; consistent as-of projection behavior is not evidenced.
native_preserve: Historical/current Site-overlap rule, direct-object 404, field disclosure gates and separate worker self-profile route.

strengths: Profile, destination Sites and manager are locked; financial fields retain an extra gate; inaccessible mutation targets are concealed 404.
gaps: Shared manage authority and FormRequest/global-scope mismatch weaken exact authority.
PUT can change is_active outside the governed transition; no revision, reason or preserved field history; opposing writes are last-writer-wins.
native_preserve: Mutation seam, all-assigned-Site check, related-object locks, financial gate and mover workflow.

strengths: All assigned Sites and actor graph are locked; inaccessible targets are concealed before validation; held-asset alerts are deduplicated.
gaps: No independent set-active authority and generic update can bypass the transition.
Activation silently restores account approval; deactivation lacks account alignment/status journal; reason/effective-time history is absent; opposing commands are last-writer-wins.
native_preserve: Canonical mutation lock, all-Site access check, pre-validation concealment and held-asset alert behavior.

strengths: Locked transaction preserves prior-stint JSON, cancels offboarding, restores the existing identity and enforces role-assignment gates.
gaps: Shared manage authority is not exact rehire authority; complete new-Site and lookup concealment is not established.
Rehire implicitly activates, restores login, synchronizes roles and triggers invite-related effects; no canonical episode/overlap or concurrent rehire-create contract is established.
native_preserve: Existing identity continuity, prior-stint preservation, offboarding cancellation, transaction and role gates.

strengths: All assigned Sites are rechecked under profile lock and token creation/notification occur after commit.
gaps: No independent invite authority or durable invitation lifecycle/provenance is established.
Repeated requests replace tokens and send multiple notifications; enumeration resistance is unproven; create/rehire use a separate reset-link implementation.
native_preserve: Profile lock, all-Site recheck, after-commit delivery and branded notification.

strengths: Version/status schemas are identified and rehire JSON plus generic audit logs are correctly excluded as substitutes.
gaps: No production writer, exact history-view authority, governed projection, append-only originating-action chain, stable snapshot, or history direct-object/privacy workflow.
native_preserve: Existing dormant history models/tables and strict non-collision with rehire JSON and generic audits.
